entities.name: Magnesium-chelatase ChlI
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt O50312, a 346-residue magnesium-chelatase 38 kDa subunit.
ATP-binding subunit of magnesium chelatase; EC 6.6.1.1.
Pfam supports Mg_chelatase domain (PF01078) and AAA_lid_2 domain (PF17863).

entities.name: Mg-protoporphyrin formation
observations: Protoporphyrin IX + Mg2+ + ATP + H2O → Mg-protoporphyrin IX + ADP + phosphate + 3 H+; Rhea RHEA:13961, EC 6.6.1.1.

entities.name: Bacteriochlorophyll biosynthesis
observations: The protein contributes to bacteriochlorophyll biosynthesis by supplying the ATP-dependent magnesium-chelatase subunit that inserts Mg2+ into protoporphyrin IX.
Related homologs also occur in chlorophyll biosynthesis, but the exact-match reference is from Chlorobaculum parvum and is annotated for bacteriochlorophyll biosynthesis.
